claude_proposed_widenings.name: bind_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-fail effect of Planar Binding is persistent compelled service: the target must follow the caster's commands for the duration. No existing Effect type or v4 atom covers behavioral command-binding of an independent creature. The Effect union only has DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The v4 atom command_companion covers commanding a companion you created; bind_creature covers compelling an independent creature to serve.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A bound creature must follow your commands to the best of its ability. You might command the creature to accompany you on an adventure, to guard a location, or to deliver a message.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: slot_scaled_duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Duration field is a fixed header value with no slot-scaling variant. Planar Binding's duration scales non-linearly with slot level (L5: 24 hr, L6: 10 days, L7: 30 days, L8: 180 days, L9: 366 days). A ThresholdTiers<DurationValue> variant on Duration (or a new DurationAmount type analogous to DiceAmount) is needed to express this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The duration increases with a spell slot of level 6 (10 days), 7 (30 days), 8 (180 days), and 9 (366 days).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extend_spell_duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: If the bound creature was summoned by another active spell, Planar Binding extends that spell's duration to match its own. No existing atom or relation in v4 models inter-spell duration manipulation (one spell modifying another spell's lifecycle node).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the creature was summoned or created by another spell, that spell's duration is extended to match the duration of this spell.
